Brand
Refraction
A disc cut by a plane of glass. The upper half sits in air; the lower half is seen through the glass and appears displaced. Content stays sharp, the glass layer bends the light — the product in one shape.
Grid 48 · two semicircles r 18.5 · gap 2.6 · offset 5.6 · monochrome; colour comes from context.
